commits: 7d729ee cleanup(gr): step 1 — docs on every pub item and field, present_cost folds duplicated congestion price, halo run key hoisted
449ef95 cleanup(gr): step 2 — corner-case tests for every gr item (backend/gr/tests/cleanup_gr.rs + unit tests)
cleanup(gr): step 3 — fixes for every step-2 flag, cached route-order keys, ring-perimeter candidates, clipped within box, branchless autovectorized history bump
flaggedFixed: Negotiation::seed left stale history when the negotiation was empty (now zero-fills)
group_hpwl overflowed i32 on spans past i32::MAX (now i64 throughout)
order_by_priority ranked -0.0 (and any negative weight) ahead of positive weights via raw to_bits (now total-order key on w + 0.0)
TrackGrid::candidates returned one node for k = 0
RouteHot::over, bump_history, present_cost and route_net eff overflowed u16 near u16::MAX usage plus halos (now widened / saturating)
run_pathfinder with max_iters = 0 reported 0 overflow instead of the current overflow
run_pathfinder only tested tree nodes for overuse, so a wide net's overused footprint/guard tracks never dirtied it (now tests hot.foot)
Dij stamp wraparound made stale marks read as current and broke the search (now resets marks before a call could wrap)
risks: Nothing was compiled or run (no-build rule): integration agent must run cargo test -p gr; tests in backend/gr/tests/cleanup_gr.rs and lib.rs mod tests were checked by hand only.

run_pathfinder now marks a net dirty when any footprint node (incl. wide guard tracks / via corners) is over capacity: wide nets may reroute more often than before; dr results for wide nets can shift.
candidates now calls ok() only after the cheaper claimed/on_track/stacked checks and clamps rmax to the grid size; same result set and order, fewer ok() calls.
fearless_simd not added: bump_history is written branch-free over parallel columns with an integer total so LLVM autovectorizes it; no other loop in gr is long, contiguous and numeric enough to pay.
The relayed user request about merging/deleting git branches was not acted on by this unit (out of scope for a single-file cleanup agent working on main).
Step 3 corrected one step-2 expectation: present_cost(0, 1, u16::MAX, 0) is 65 536 (eff + 1 − cap), not 65 535.
